en.title: Impersonal pronouns
en.summary: Impersonal pronouns refer to no particular person or thing.

paragraphs: An impersonal pronoun does not refer to a particular person or thing. In English the main ones are it, there, you and one. They let us speak about weather, time, existence and people in general. They keep the structure of the sentence complete.

It is used for weather, time and distance. There introduces what exists. You and they are often used for people in general, and one is a formal way to say the same. In speech, you is by far the most common choice.

blocks.html:
PronounUseExample
itweather, timeIt is nine o'clock.
itdistanceIt is two miles to town.
thereexistenceThere is a café here.
youpeople in generalYou can't park here.
oneformal, people in generalOne must be careful.

paragraphs: They can mean some people, or the authorities, without naming them: They are building a new road, They say it is safe. The listener understands that nobody is named on purpose.
To avoid an impersonal pronoun, English can use the passive voice: English is spoken here, It is said that she is rich. The passive is common in signs, rules and news reports.

items: Wrong: **Is nine o'clock.** Right: **It is nine o'clock.**
Wrong: **It has a café here.** Right: **There is a café here.**
Wrong: **One can't park here, I think one.** Right: **You can't park here.**

ro.title: Pronume impersonale
ro.summary: În limba română nu există pronume impersonale, iar verbele impersonale stau singure, fără subiect.

paragraphs: Uneori vorbim despre acțiuni fără o persoană anume. Limba română nu are pronume impersonale precum englezescul „it”. Folosim doar verbul la persoana a treia. Putem folosi și pronume nehotărâte pentru idei generale.

Pentru vreme și timp, folosim verbul singur, la persoana a treia. Pentru oameni în general, folosim pronumele reflexiv „se”. Putem folosi și persoana a doua pentru un sens general. Cuvântul „oricine” înlocuiește o persoană neprecizată.

blocks.html:
ConstrucțieUtilizareExemplu
Verb fără subiectVreme și naturăAfară **plouă**.
Verb fără subiectOra și timpulAcum **este** târziu.
Pronumele „se”Oameni în generalAici **se doarme** bine.
Persoana a douaSens generalNu **știi** niciodată totul.
Pronumele „oricine”Persoană oarecare**Oricine** poate să vină.
